sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Skips splash ads and the consent request and opens the app immediately.
Disables the after call screen and hides its entry in settings.
Disables the rate us feedback screen and the periodic rate us prompt.
Removes the battery optimization request on the dashboard.
Skips the permission and call setup pages shown after the language selection.
Keeps the system navigation keys visible.
Unlocks premium features and hides the premium entry in settings.
